description: An expander for cvOSCcv that adds 8 more voltages to send out as Open Sound Control messages

inputs.text: A rising edge here sends that channel's value out as a message
The voltage that channel sends; a polyphonic cable sends one value per channel in the same message

notes: place this immediately to the left of cvOSCcv, or of another input expander already attached to it; it does nothing on its own
each channel's address is set on the cvOSCcv configuration screen, which the arrow buttons there move along the chain of expanders

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
